integrity: The proof evaluates all surviving multiplicity patterns analytically through degree six. A finite exhaustive checker is included only as corroboration and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The formulas require redundancy-freeness; algebraic relations among distinct Pauli terms can add trace words. General weighted sixth-order data determine only Q_x+W_x-T_x, while exact triangle recovery additionally assumes equal nonzero coupling magnitudes and graph regularity. No full graph reconstruction or complexity converse is claimed.
title: Low-order thermal cumulants recover local invariants of redundancy-free Pauli anticommutation graphs
